name: Box2D
summary: Complete 2D physics with Box2D-Lite: boxes, joints, contacts, queries and DebugDraw.
description: Wraps Box2D-Lite (Erin Catto, MIT license) into one module. It provides a world with gravity, solver switches and iteration count, dynamic and static boxes, point-to-point joints, forces, impulses, mass and friction control, readable body state including rotated corners, a contact list with position, normal, depth and impulse, point and ray queries, and a DebugDraw overlay that draws shapes, centres, velocities, contacts, normals, joints and bounds with the normal GBX drawing commands. The first run compiles the INLINE block with g++.
author: GameBasiX
